newsitem.title: USA: IPO SPOTLIGHT - Coffee People market debut.
newsitem.headline: IPO SPOTLIGHT - Coffee People market debut.

text.p: Coffee People Inc is expected to make its Wall Street debut Wednesday, hoping to carve out a niche of the coffee retail market dominated by industry leader Starbucks Corp.
The company is offering 1,062,500 shares in an estimated range of $8.50 to $10.50 a share. Black & Co is the lead underwriter of the offering.
"We believe the specialty coffee market will continue to be among the most attractive in the retail sub-segment," said Alex Brown and Sons analyst Christopher Vroom.
